steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Exact values: are the precise values of trigonometric functions for special angles, written as fractions or surds rather than decimals. | Why learn these?: They appear frequently in exams and simplify calculations without a calculator.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Write down the exact value of sin 60°. | Write down the exact value of tan 45°. | Calculate sin 30° × cos 60°.
